root_text.title: නළපාන ජාතකය
root_text.author: A.P. de Zoysa
root_text.text:
• ඛුද්දකනිකාය
  • ජාතක
  • (පඨමො භාගො)
  • 1. එකක නිපාතය
  • 2. සීල වර්ගය

20. නළපාන ජාතකය

Msdiv 20“ගොඩට නැංගාවූ පියවර නොදැක දියට බැස්සාවූ පියවරද දැක බට නළයකින් ජලය පානය කරන්නෙමු. තෝ මා නොම වධකරන්නෙහි යයි” කීයේය.

නළපානජාතකං දසමං.

සීලවග්ගො දුතියො.

AP de Zoysa edition.

Permission to publish was kindly granted by Kumari Jayawardhana.

Digital files were kindly supplied by Sirisumana Godage of Godage International Publishing, who publish a print edition of this text.

Conversion from PDF was by Janaka of http://pitaka.lk/.

The assistance of Amaradasa Liyanagamage, Ven Mettavihari and Maithri Panagoda is gratefully acknowledged.

Prepared for SuttaCentral by Ayya Kathrin Vimalañāṇī.

suttaplex.blurb: “I found the footprints.” This story was told by the Master whilst journeying on an alms-pilgrimage through Kosala, when he had come to the village of Nalaka-pana (Cane-drink) and was dwelling at Ketaka-vana near the Pool of Nalaka-pana, about cane-sticks. In those days the Brethren, after bathing in the Pool of Nalaka-pana, made the novices get them cane-sticks for needle-cases, but, finding them hollow throughout, went to the Master and said, “Sir, we had cane-sticks got in order to provide needle-cases; and from top to bottom they are quite hollow. Now how can that be?”
